title: Imprint of the 2015-2016 El Nino on South China Sea heat content
query: Using the supplied CMOMS daily temperature, salinity and velocity for 2011-2020, determine how the 2015-2016 El Nino changed the upper-ocean heat content and circulation of the South China Sea, when the anomaly built up and decayed, and through which processes. No ENSO index or surface fluxes are supplied.
